title: Auckland Gym Deals
meta_desc: Find the best gym deals in Auckland, including current joining offers, free trials, and the Exercise NZ subsidy scheme for eligible members.
intro: Auckland has the widest selection of gyms in NZ, from budget 24/7 clubs to premium facilities in the CBD. City Fitness and Les Mills dominate the market, with strong presence from other popular gyms. Here are the best gym deals in Auckland for July 2026.

sections.heading: Current Gym Deals in Auckland
sections.body: Several gyms in Auckland are offering attractive deals for new members. Jetts is offering 15% off plus 4 weeks free, while Snap Fitness is giving away 6 weeks free. Les Mills has introduced a flexi membership with no lock-in contract, and City Fitness is providing a month-to-month membership for $18.99/week.
list: Les Mills: Flexi membership with no lock-in contract

sections.heading: Exercise NZ Subsidy Scheme
sections.body: To be eligible for the subsidy, members must meet specific criteria, such as being a new member or having not been a member of a gym for at least 12 months. The subsidy amount varies depending on the gym and the membership type.

sections.heading: Best Value Gyms in Auckland
sections.body: City Fitness is currently the best value gym in Auckland, offering a full-service membership for $18.99/week. Les Mills is also a popular choice, with a strong presence in the city and a range of group fitness classes.
list: Les Mills: Premium gym with a range of group fitness classes

sections.heading: Money-Saving Tips for Joining a Gym in Auckland
sections.body: Here are some tips to help you save money when joining a gym in Auckland: consider a month-to-month membership instead of a long-term contract, look for gyms that offer a free trial or discount for new members, and take advantage of the Exercise NZ subsidy scheme if you are eligible.
list: Look for gyms with a free trial or discount for new members
Take advantage of the Exercise NZ subsidy scheme
Compare prices and services between gyms
Negotiate with the gym if possible
